Franchises; Sale and Lease of Certain Public Property

law.catch_line: Granting franchises for operation of a vehicular ferry transportation system
law.text: The authority granted by this article for the granting of franchises by localities shall include the authority to grant an exclusive franchise for the operation of a vehicular ferry transportation system in Northumberland County. The county may regulate such system, including the establishment of fees and rates.
